final: WITH type_avgs AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS baseline_price FROM type_avgs), kept AS (SELECT t.avg_price FROM type_avgs AS t CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE t.avg_price > b.baseline_price), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS mean_price FROM kept), remaining AS (SELECT k.avg_price FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m WHERE k.avg_price > m.mean_price) SELECT (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM remaining) AS avg_type_price, (SELECT AVG(avg_price - b.baseline_price) FROM remaining) AS avg_above_baseline, (SELECT AVG(avg_price - m.mean_price) FROM remaining) AS avg_above_kept_mean FROM baseline AS b CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m WHERE b.baseline_price IS NOT NULL
